covered.rule: Call variables ... Address the person as title + last name
1. opening sentence
1. do not mention arrears, overdue amounts, a facility or payments before verification
2. Am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?
2. unclear: ask one more time, then unreached/unclear
3. callback next business day only, 09:00-17:30 inclusive, ask once, no_callback / callback
3. wrong number -> unreached/wrong_number
3. died -> 'Please accept our condolences.' unreached/deceased
4. postcode, founded year, company number (eight digits), in order
4. two wrong answers in total -> contact the business desk, unverified/failed
4. explain once; second refusal unverified/declined
5. 'business overdraft', 'equipment loan', 'trade finance line'
6. Monday-Friday except six Northbridge holidays
7 overridden by memo (a): 1-10 band, 7th business day, one attempt
7. 11-60 band, 5 business days, two attempts
8. full first; minimum_due for overdraft, scheduled_repayment for loan/trade line; floor once; remainder stays in arrears; accept between; never ask how much
9. today or later, business day, roll forward, after deadline offer deadline, vague ask once
10. attempt 1 full on last business day this week (or next); attempt 2 floor on deadline (11-60 only)
10. attempts used up -> no_arrangement/declined_payment
11. 'Can I record that?', only after clear yes
11. try once more, then no_arrangement/system_error
11. 'A confirmation will be sent to the registered email address.'
12. already settled -> settled
12. disputed -> no_arrangement/disputed
12. reschedule / reduce repayments -> queue restructure, handed_over/restructure
12. request for a person -> ask once, queue desk, handed_over/person
12. financial distress -> offer care; handed_over/care or no_arrangement/distress
12. is the call genuine -> number on statement, continue
13. exactly one close_call, last; thank and say goodbye before
memo (b) up to three facilities
memo (b) state all, ask once about today, one by one in get_account order, attempts per facility
memo (b) one read-back, one create_promise per facility
memo (b) single date after a facility's deadline -> that facility's deadline, said in read-back
memo (b) add_note reasons; no notes on handed-over call
memo (b) closing: arrangement unless handed over; settled if all settled; else first non-settled note reason
